title: Fixture-only Research Console usability acknowledgement
acceptance_conditions: The fixture console is recognisably within the approved dark 16:9 product family and is usable as an operator research surface.
SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE, NON_EVIDENTIARY and AUTHORITY EFFECT NONE remain persistent and legible.
Healthy, inactive-C2E, null/residual, authority-denied and dense fixture states are understandable without fabricating source state.
C2E absence is shown honestly as NOT_MATERIALIZED with source reason rather than legacy substitution.
AVAILABLE, AUTHORISED and ACTIVE remain visibly independent.
1920x1080, 1440x810 and 1280x720 retain critical labels and minimum primary-canvas heights.
Interaction controls remain navigation/presentation only and cannot mutate evidence or authority.
Operator accepts or explicitly defers the initial visual/usability baseline; automated screenshots are candidate evidence, not self-ratifying visual authority.
